purpose: Expose a compact public rights/provenance summary without publishing private contracts, customer data or unsupported cultural-authenticity claims.
cultural_material_rule: State whether material is original D’AUBE interpretation, commissioned, licensed, sourced under an open/public-domain basis, or only research/reference. Do not imply community endorsement, traditional authority or geographic authenticity without evidence.
truth_boundary: Attribution is evidence about source and rights, not a certification of cultural authenticity, product quality, production status or commercial success.
